title: Non-Existence of Multi-Qubit Pauli-Covariant MUB Fiducial States and Alltop Phase Functions on F_2^n (n >= 3)
description: Self-contained, pure-kernel Lean 4 formalization (v4.36.0, 10 audited declarations, zero sorry, zero native_decide, standard foundational axioms only), reproducible companion scripts, and full manuscript proving that for all n >= 3, no n-qubit pure state generates 2^n pairwise mutually unbiased orthonormal bases under the n-qubit Pauli (product Weyl-Heisenberg) group and no Alltop phase function exists on F_2^n. Resolves Conjecture 1 and the unrestricted product-WH MUB question of Damski et al. (arXiv:2603.15550) and rules out the product WH-MUB mechanism conjectured by Liu, Low, and Yin (Quantum Sci. Technol. 11, 015035, 2026; Open Quantum Problem E28) for maximizing stabilizer Renyi entropy at n >= 4. AI-assistance disclosure: the bulk of the technical work (proof discovery, Lean 4 formalization, companion scripts, and manuscript drafting) was carried out using AI systems under the author's problem selection and oversight; mathematical validity of all formalized theorems is independently checked end-to-end by Lean 4's pure kernel (Audit.lean).
